title: Lead Time/Shipping/FAQ – Defiant Machine WorksMenu
text: LEADTIME Once the order is in our hands, it will be completed in 2 weeks or less. You will be contacted and updated if we encounter any issues or slowdowns while working on your firearm. Do you offer expedited or rushed services?Yes, we do. Pricing is listed below. Please email sales@defiantmachineworks.com to order rushed services, as we want to be sure we can meet your timeline.1 Week – $1253 Day – $22524HR Turnaround – $350 Do you offer in-person drop-off or pick-up if I am local?Yes, we do. When placing your order, you can use code “localdrop” so you don’t have to pay shipping. Once the order is placed, you will be contacted via text or email to schedule a time to drop off your firearm. SHIPPING Once you place an order, you will receive full shipping instructions via email, but here are a few notes. Shipping process for FIREARMS/SERIALIZED FRAMES:It is federally legal for you to ship directly to us. However, changes to UPS and FedEx policies make it more secure for all involved to use a local FFL (gun shop, pawn shop, gunsmith, etc.). We would greatly appreciate it if you chose this route. It gives both parties more peace of mind. Having it shipped through an FFL is also often less expensive. Shipping process for SLIDES AND NON-SERIALIZED PARTS: (SIG grip modules with FCU removed and 2011 grips removed from the frame)Feel free to ship USPS or UPS. Who is responsible for shipping costs?The shipping charge you see at checkout is for us to send the completed firearm, frame, or slide back to you. You will still be responsible for paying to ship the firearm, frame, or slide to us. Please see our shipping directions for how to ship those. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Once the order is in our hands, it will be completed in 2 weeks or less. You will be contacted and updated if we encounter any issues or slowdowns while working on your firearm. Can I edit an order once I place it? We highly recommend that you know what you want before placing an order. Depending on our workload, we might have already started work on your firearms, so we can’t guarantee that we will be able to make changes, though here is our general rule. Local drop-off orders have a 24-hour window to make changes to the order. Shipped orders have a 72-hour window to make changes to the order. Can I cancel my order? If you cancel your order before shipping your firearm to us, you will receive a refund of 75% of the order total. Once the firearm has been shipped to us, the order is non-refundable. Can you fix a bad stipple job or update my current stippling?You should email us photos at sales@defiantmachineworks.com so we can check them out and tell you what we think can be done. It all depends on the firearm’s model and what has already been done. Do you charge a Disassembly/Reassembly fee?We do not charge a disassembly/reassembly fee for all services listed on the site. Can you re-mill an existing optic cut or a factory optic cut?No, once a slide has been milled, we cannot mill it for something else.For Glock MOS slides, we can remove the locating studs to make them 507k footprint compatible. What is Cerakote?Cerakote is a ceramic-based finish that protects various surfaces. It is known for its excellent resistance to wear, corrosion, and chemicals, making it ideal for harsh environments. The application process involves spray coating, which allows for a wide range of colors and custom designs. Cerakote also enhances the item’s aesthetic appeal while maintaining its functionality. I want a camo or Cerakote job that is different from what is listed.Please email us at sales@defiantmachineworks.com or call/text us at 931-266-2422 to discuss your custom Cerakote needs. What color Cerakote do you offer?Cerakote offers many colors. Please click HERE to see all the options.

title: D95 Compensator for Glock Gen 5-6 – Defiant Machine WorksMenu
text: Skip to content D95 Compensator for Glock Gen 5-6 $105.00 Precision-machined compensator for Gen 5 & 6 Glocks, 1/2×28 thread. Black finish. Reduces muzzle rise and keeps you on target. Ships ready to install. Description The Defiant Machine Works D95 is designed to fit the contour of the Glock Gen 6 AND Gen 5 slides. The D95 was made in collaboration with Herrington Arms using their proven and effective comp design but adding our aestetic touch. The D95 will work with the stock springs provided your gun has gone through our recommended break in period of 500 rounds of factory new ammunition with the threaded barrel you intend to use with the firearm before installing a compensator. We’ve found that this compensator has a 34% muzzle flip reduction depending on what 9mm load and Glock model is used. Specifications Material : 7075 Aluminum Finish : Black Anodized Compatibility : Models: Glock 17/19/26/45/34/19x/47 (including the MOS models of) with 1/2-28 Barrels and must be GEN 5 or GEN 6 Glocks Included : 5/64 Allen key – Steel replacement 8-32 set screw Length : 1.0″ long Holster Compatibility : Will fit in most open bottom holsters. We use Tier 1 Concealed, and Safariland. Will not work with aftermarket slides. Highlights Designed to work with most 1/2-28 threaded 9mm barrels. Made from USA-sourced 7075 aluminum. Designed, assembled, and machined in the USA. 3 port design to mitigate vertical and felt recoil NOT COMPATIBLE WITH SILENCERCO, BAR-STO, KKM, OR EFK BARRELS! Works with all gen 5 and Gen 6 Glock 9mm models AMMO DISCLAIMER: We DO NOT recommend using plated, bi-metal, or frangible ammo in ANY of our compensators. Doing so will void the warranty and we will not cover or replace the comp if there are any damages. INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS Make sure all threads are clean of grease, carbon, and loctite. Wipe the threads down till they’re clean. If the threads are not cleaned, the loctite will not set properly. Only use loctite 243 on the barrel AND set screw threads. Some versions of the blue Loctite are not very strong and will not hold up. Feel free to use a generous amount. Torque the set screws to no more than 18in/lbs. Allow the loctite to set for 24-48 hours before using. Please be sure that the compensator is not touching the slide, frame, or guide rod as that can cause cycling issues. Restricted states: This product cannot be shipped to CA, NY, NJ, HI, IL, MD, MA, or WA. In stock D95 Compensator for Glock Gen 5-6 quantity Add to cart

title: Bodyguard 2.0 Viper Ports – Defiant Machine WorksMenu
text: Skip to content Bodyguard 2.0 Viper Ports $225.00 This precision machining upgrade is designed specifically for the Smith & Wesson Bodyguard 2.0 Standard model. Our custom Viper Ports are strategically cut into the slide and barrel to vent gases upward, significantly reducing muzzle rise and felt recoil. This helps keep your sights on target for faster follow-up shots, especially beneficial in the compact .380 ACP platform, where recoil can feel snappy. Key Benefits: Reduces muzzle flip and overall recoil for flatter shooting Improves shot-to-shot recovery and control Professional CNC machining for precise, consistent results Maintains reliability with the factory recoil system Important Compatibility Notes: For Standard Bodyguard 2.0 models only (with the non-ported, non-compensated barrel/slide setup). Not for the Performance Center Carry Comp variant (longer ported barrel and different slide cuts). Send-in service: Ship your slide, barrel, and related components for professional installation and finishing. Bodyguard 2.0 Viper Ports quantity Add to cart

title: Genesis OEM Slide Mill – Defiant Machine WorksMenu
text: Skip to content Genesis OEM Slide Mill $225.00 We designed the Genesis slide with the modern shooter in mind. We wanted milling that provided aggressive texturing up front to help with manipulating the slide but not something that would tear up your holster or hands. We also added the matching texture to the rear of the slide in case you aren’t running an optic and prefer to manipulate the slide from the rear. With windows on all three sides of the slide, we have reduced weight to help with felt recoil and allow the option for barrel ports. We also think it looks cool, but we might be slightly biased. Disclaimer—This is an OEM slide milling package for a customer-supplied slide. After placing the order, you will receive email instructions on shipping your slide to us. OPTIC CUT 17/19x/19/45/47/34 SPECIAL NOTES: Due to design constraints, the GLOCK 41 cannot be milled. Optics will be moved as far back as possible when selecting Front or Delete irons. We cannot optic cut slides that already have optic mounting solutions (MOS). OPTIC CUT 43/43x/48 SPECIAL NOTES: Optics will be moved as far back as possible when selecting Front or Delete irons. We cannot optic cut slides that already have optic mounting solutions (MOS). If selecting MOS Rear Stud Delete, this cut deletes rear MOS studs to allow direct mounting of K Series/EPS carry optic.
